established: All ten law/seed conditions fail the frozen complete G3 criteria.
Seeds 11/23/37/53 pass the fresh MAP/action/goal checks but fail bilingual probability agreement and conditional probability quality.
For those four seeds the worst bilingual pair contains a new SET expression at VOS and a physically equivalent expression at a taught layout, with correct action MAP at both points.
New SET probability quality also fails in taught SVO/OSV cells; held VOS is not the only defect.
Seeds 23/37/53 fail mean NLL retention on saturation/centering/coordinate banks under both laws.
Seed 37 has 128 action MAP changes per failing bank/law, all to menu index 3 (SET second), plus exact-world regressions.
The implemented scalar interaction c(word)*q(layout) enters both effect selection and role selection.
hypotheses: Learned layout magnitude changes effect confidence, contributing to VOS probability drift and old-word effect leakage; saved evidence supports this but does not isolate causality.
Residual finite-budget probability calibration contributes alongside layout coupling; saved training curves were still improving.
The isolated probability-neutral normalization may improve optimization and confidence, but still makes family probability depend on c*q and therefore cannot structurally guarantee all broader gates.
